entries.title: Psalms 17:1
segments:
Feigned; insincere. 
 
Sincerity of soul in our prayers is essential to acceptance with God. He searches the heart and tries the reins of the children of men, and those who worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

entries.title: Psalms 17:3
segments: In the night; when the mind is free from outward occupations, and its true bent is manifested most clearly.

entries.title: Psalms 17:4
segments:
The works of men; their evil works. 
 
  By the word of thy lips; by giving heed to it.

From the paths of the destroyer; from walking in his paths; that is, imitating his ways.  The destroyer is the wicked and bloody oppressor of his fellow-men, who makes himself rich and great by violence and falsehood. 
 
The words of the Lord are the great means of keeping his people from those paths of iniquity which end in ruin.

entries.title: Psalms 17:8
segments:
As the apple of the eye; in perfect safety. 
 
Confidence in God is the grand means of security, and those who trust in him shall be kept in perfect safety.

entries.title: Psalms 17:10
segments: They are inclosed in their own fat; or, they have shut up their fat, that is, their fat heart.  They have pampered themselves by self-indulgence, and thus become hard-hearted and insensible in respect to both God and man.

entries.title: Psalms 17:11
segments: They have set their eyes bowing down to the earth; as a beast of prey before he springs upon his victim.  But we may better render, "They have set their eyes [upon the righteous] to cast [him] down to the earth."

entries.title: Psalms 17:13
segments: Thy sword; the instrument by which God punishes his people.

entries.title: Psalms 17:15
segments:
When I awake; in the world to come. 
 
  With thy likeness; with beholding thy likeness.  To behold the likeness of God, is to behold God himself.  So

, where the original word is the same. 
 
As the beatific vision of God in heaven is reserved for all the righteous, they have no occasion to envy rich and prosperous sinners who have their portion in this life.
